description: Repository facade renovation to align the public repo with the published AWS blog. This is a documentation-only change: rewrite the root README.md to reflect the 'one-click self-service Spot GPU inference testing environment' positioning, migrate the existing deep-dive benchmark content into a new docs/ file (nothing dropped), create platform/README.md with the platform's own deploy/run instructions grounded in the CDK code, and add a root LICENSE file with the MIT-0 full text. No .py/.ts/.yaml/CDK/compose code is touched. All four sub-deliverables are one coherent unit of work.
steps: STEP 1 - Migrate deep-dive content: Create docs/benchmark-methodology.md (Chinese, keep existing writing style). Move the existing README.md body from section '1. 结论摘要（TL;DR）' through section '12. 客户验收标准与测试需求' (i.e. everything after the '0.x' quick-start/reports blocks) VERBATIM into this file so no technical content is lost: TL;DR, 场景与负载, MTP/EAGLE 投机解码, 拓扑方案对比, 硬件候选, 测试矩阵, 待客户确认问题, 两个结构性问题, 已完成环境验证(POC), 权威信息源, 不确定性声明, 客户验收标准/测试需求/结果矩阵/Spot 启动策略. Give the file a clear H1 title (e.g. '# DeepSeek-V4-Flash 推理选型测试方案（深度技术文档）') and a short lead line noting it is the internal benchmark working document referenced from the root README. Do NOT alter the technical content, tables, or numbers while moving.

STEP 2 - Rewrite root README.md aligned to the blog. Chinese primary. Cover these sections in order (headings may be tuned): (a) Title tied to the blog (e.g. '从 0 到推理：AWS Spot GPU 一键自助推理测试环境'), one-line intro, a markdown link to the blog https://aws.amazon.com/cn/blogs/china/0-inference-aws-spot-gpu-inference-testing-environment/ , and an MIT-0 + 'AWS sample, not a supported product' notice (both zh + en sentence, matching the blog). (b) '这是什么 / 解决什么痛点' - condense the blog's three pain points -> three solution lines (Spot + capacity poller; React self-service portal; DynamoDB record + History page + Lark/飞书 notifications). (c) '架构总览' - Serverless control plane (React/Vite on S3 + CloudFront; API via CloudFront -> API Gateway; Lambda authorizer Basic Auth; four Python Lambdas api/poller/deployer/orphan-cleaner coordinated by EventBridge; DynamoDB) + multi-region (us-east-1/us-east-2/us-west-2) EC2 Spot GPU data plane; describe the four Lambdas and data flow with a text table (do NOT invent an image path; if no diagram asset exists, use text/table only). (d) '快速开始 / 部署' - a condensed version that points to platform/README.md as the authoritative steps (relative link ./platform/README.md): prerequisites, cdk deploy, upload frontend, configure 飞书, how to book/release. (e) '部署方案与自定义上传' - docker-compose describes the topology; built-in plans; portal 「方案管理」page custom upload (方案名 + 机型 + .yaml, redeploy to take effect); explicitly note modelName is now auto-parsed from the compose yaml; link ./platform/docs/UPDATE-COMPOSE.md. (f) '为什么用 Spot' - condense Spot vs Capacity Block vs ODCR trade-off; ~2h interruptible workload -> Spot cheapest, poller grabs capacity each minute, auto-reclaim on failure. (g) '成本与三重防护' - concurrency cap (H200 and B300 each max 1 concurrent), 飞书 alerts on every key state change, timeout auto-cleanup (deploy timeout / idle timeout + 15-min orphan cleaner), plus the P5/P6 burn-rate warning (tens of USD/hour). (h) '仓库结构导航' - platform/ = platform proper; reports/ = real measured data; scripts/ + infra/ = older benchmark route; docs/ = ops/postmortem. (i) '实测数据 / 选型方法论' - KEEP the existing 0.1 Benchmark Reports result table (the one with TPOT/throughput) either in the root README or link to it; link to docs/benchmark-methodology.md (the migrated deep-dive) and to reports/ (link all four report dirs: reports/h200-tp4-eagle-20260809/, reports/b300-tp8-eagle-20260809/, reports/b300-h200-luna-sweep-20260810/, reports/b300-pd-customer-validation-20260810/). (j) License section referencing ./LICENSE and the MIT-0 sample notice. Ensure NO real account 077090643075 appears anywhere in the README; use placeholders. Use relative links for in-repo files and the full URL for the blog.

STEP 3 - Create platform/README.md (Chinese, keep style). Platform's own deploy/run guide grounded ONLY in the CDK code facts (do not invent CDK behavior or nonexistent scripts). Cover: 前置条件 (AWS account + CDK bootstrap; Node/npm; Python 3.12; create SSM SecureString /tpot-booking/basic-auth-credentials with value 'username:password' via `aws ssm put-parameter --type SecureString`; PRE-PROVISION the security group tpot-bench-noingress-sg and the per-region subnets in us-east-1/us-east-2/us-west-2 - state clearly these are prerequisites NOT created by the stack, since the poller only Describes them; note the stack DOES create IAM role tpot-bench-ec2-role + instance profile tpot-bench-ec2-profile). 构建前端 (cd frontend && npm install && npm run build -> produces frontend/dist which CDK uploads). CDK 部署 (npm install at platform/; cdk bootstrap; cdk deploy; how to override account/region/modelName via -c context, using <YOUR_ACCOUNT_ID> placeholder, referencing default region us-east-1). 拿 Outputs (list all 8 CfnOutputs: ApiUrl, CloudFrontDomain, BookingTableName, NotificationConfigTableName, DeploymentPlanTableName, NotificationTopicArn, FrontendBucketName, ComposeBucketName; note the portal is reached via the CloudFront domain and the frontend calls relative /api/*). 配飞书 webhook (via portal Settings page, or API POST/PUT /notifications and POST /notifications/test-webhook). 预约/释放流程 (portal BookingPage to submit a booking selecting instance type + plan + whitelist IP; release/terminate via portal or DELETE /bookings/{bookingId}; poller grabs Spot capacity, deployer uses SSM + docker compose to bring up SGLang and health-check, orphan-cleaner reclaims). API 路由 summary table (the 7 route groups). 更新 compose 而不 cdk deploy - link ./docs/UPDATE-COMPOSE.md (relative to platform/). List the 7 built-in compose files / plan ids from platform/docs/UPDATE-COMPOSE.md note 3. Use <YOUR_ACCOUNT_ID> placeholder in every example command; never write 077090643075.

STEP 4 - Create root LICENSE file containing the exact standard MIT No Attribution (MIT-0) license full text. Copyright line: 'Copyright (c) Amazon.com, Inc. or its affiliates. All Rights Reserved.' followed by the standard MIT-0 body (permission granted ... without restriction ... The above copyright notice ... THE SOFTWARE IS PROVIDED "AS IS" ...). Use the canonical MIT-0 wording (MIT-0 omits the 'copyright notice must be included' obligation compared to MIT).
acceptance_criteria: docs/benchmark-methodology.md exists and contains the full deep-dive technical content (sections 1-12 of the old README) with tables/numbers unchanged; no technical content was dropped from the repo.

Root README.md is rewritten to the blog positioning and includes: blog link, MIT-0 + 'not a supported product' notice, three pain points -> three solution lines, serverless + multi-region Spot architecture overview with a four-Lambda table, condensed deploy section linking ./platform/README.md, deployment-plans + custom-upload section (mentioning modelName auto-parsed from yaml) linking ./platform/docs/UPDATE-COMPOSE.md, why-Spot, cost + triple guardrails + burn warning, repo-structure navigation, the preserved 0.1 benchmark results table (or a link to it), links to docs/benchmark-methodology.md and all four reports/ dirs, and a License section linking ./LICENSE.

platform/README.md exists with deploy/run instructions consistent with lib/tpot-booking-stack.ts and bin/app.ts: prerequisites (SSM SecureString, pre-provisioned SG/subnets called out as prerequisites, Node/Python), frontend build, cdk deploy with context overrides, all 8 CfnOutputs, 飞书 config, booking/release flow, API route table, and a link to ./docs/UPDATE-COMPOSE.md.
Root LICENSE file exists and is the exact MIT-0 (MIT No Attribution) text.

The real AWS account id 077090643075 does not appear in README.md, platform/README.md, docs/benchmark-methodology.md, or LICENSE; placeholders are used instead. No real credentials or webhook URLs are leaked.
All in-repo markdown links are relative and resolve to files that exist; the blog URL is a full markdown link.
No .py, .ts, .yaml, CDK, or compose functional code was modified.
verification: Run `test -f docs/benchmark-methodology.md && test -f platform/README.md && test -f LICENSE` and confirm all exist.
grep -rn '077090643075' README.md platform/README.md docs/benchmark-methodology.md LICENSE and confirm ZERO matches.
Check every relative link target in README.md and platform/README.md exists on disk (docs/benchmark-methodology.md, platform/README.md, platform/docs/UPDATE-COMPOSE.md, LICENSE, reports/*/ dirs).
grep -n 'MIT-0\|MIT No Attribution\|AS IS' LICENSE and confirm the MIT-0 body is present.
Run `git status --porcelain` and confirm only README.md is modified and docs/benchmark-methodology.md, platform/README.md, LICENSE are added; no .py/.ts/.yaml files changed.
Spot-check the migrated docs/benchmark-methodology.md against the old README (git show HEAD:README.md) to confirm sections 1-12 content is preserved.
findings: All four deliverables completed as documentation-only edits (no .py/.ts/.yaml touched). (1) Root README.md rewritten to the blog positioning '从 0 到推理：AWS Spot GPU 一键自助推理测试环境' with blog link, MIT-0 + 'not a supported product' notice (zh+en), three pain points -> three solution lines, serverless + multi-region Spot architecture with a four-Lambda table (no invented diagram path; text/tables only), condensed deploy section linking ./platform/README.md, deployment-plans + custom-upload section noting modelName auto-parsed from yaml and linking ./platform/docs/UPDATE-COMPOSE.md, why-Spot table, cost + triple guardrails + burn warning, repo-structure navigation, the preserved 0.1 benchmark results table (kept verbatim in root README), and links to docs/benchmark-methodology.md and all four reports/ dirs. (2) docs/benchmark-methodology.md created with the old README sections 1-12 migrated VERBATIM (verified all 12 H2 sections + all 13 section-12 subsections present; tables/numbers unchanged). Only adjusted two internal relative link paths (postmortem, README) so they resolve from docs/. (3) platform/README.md created grounded strictly in cdk_facts_confirmed: prerequisites clearly split (SSM SecureString /tpot-booking/basic-auth-credentials, tpot-bench-noingress-sg SG, per-region subnets = user-provisioned; EC2 role/instance profile = stack-created), frontend build, cdk deploy with -c account/region/modelName overrides using <YOUR_ACCOUNT_ID>, all 8 CfnOutputs, 飞书 config, booking/release flow, API route table (7 route groups), Lambda/EventBridge table, and links to ./docs/UPDATE-COMPOSE.md. Compose plan table lists the 7 actual files present (not the 8 note-3 ids, since only 7 yaml files exist in the repo). (4) LICENSE created with exact MIT-0 text and copyright line 'Copyright (c) Amazon.com, Inc. or its affiliates. All Rights Reserved.'. Verification: files exist; grep '077090643075' across all four files returns ZERO matches; all relative links resolve to real files on disk; LICENSE contains 'MIT No Attribution' and 'AS IS'; git status --porcelain shows only README.md modified and docs/benchmark-methodology.md + platform/README.md + LICENSE added, no code files changed. Did not commit/push/PR per instructions.
